company.name: Ola
company.shortDescription: Ola is a mobility platform and ride-hailing company that integrates city transportation for customers and driver partners.
company.description:
Ola operates a mobile technology platform that integrates city transportation for customers and driver partners in India. Its mobile application allows its customers to book a range of cabs, auto-rickshaws, bikes, and shuttle buses. 

Ola's mobile application allows customers to book city taxi, outstation travel, car rental, and corporate travel services. Its mobile application is available on Windows, Android, and iOS platforms. 

Ankit Bhati and Bhavish Aggarwal founded Ola on December 1, 2010. It has its headquarters with additional offices in Bengaluru in India.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series J round raised $20,100,098, or 0.4% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 30 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,709,274,998 to $6,700,000,000, a 1.17x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 37 (+5 over 90 days) and market heat at 35 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
